en.title: D.C.N.E.
en.decryption: D: Dukkha (Suffering), C: Cause (Samudaya), N: Nirodha (Cessation), E: Eightfold Path (Magga - the remedy).

hi.title: D.C.N.E.
hi.decryption: D: Dukkha (Suffering), C: Cause (Samudaya), N: Nirodha (Cessation), E: Eightfold Path (Magga - the remedy).

fact.en: Thinking the 4 Noble Truths are the same as the Eightfold Path (The Truths are the diagnosis, the Path is the prescription).
fact.hi: Thinking the 4 Noble Truths are the same as the Eightfold Path (The Truths are the diagnosis, the Path is the prescription).

fact.en: Assuming Nirvana is explicitly defined in the 4 Truths; it is the implicit 'end state' of the third truth (Nirodha).
fact.hi: Assuming Nirvana is explicitly defined in the 4 Truths; it is the implicit 'end state' of the third truth (Nirodha).
